props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: size
props.description: Figma's Size. LG is the touch size.

props.name: icon
props.description: Figma's "Leading icon" + "Icon".

props.name: count
props.description: Figma's "Show count": an Info Badge after the title.

props.name: summary
props.description: Figma's "Summary" + "Show summary".

props.name: secondaryLabel
props.description: Figma's "Show secondary".

props.name: center
props.description: Centre slot, usually a DateIndicator. Figma's "Show date".

props.name: trailing
props.description: Right slot, usually an Avatar (wrap it in a button if it opens a menu).

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed plot width in px. Leave it out and the chart fills its container.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats y-axis labels; defaults to one decimal with a comma (`0,9`).

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'sm'.

props.name: initials
props.description: Initials or short label shown when there's no image.

props.name: color
props.description: Default 'neutral'.

props.name: color
props.description: Maps to Figma's "Color" variant.

props.name: title
props.description: Optional bold first line — Figma's "Title" boolean + "Title text".

props.name: action
props.description: Optional single underlined text action — Figma's "Action" boolean + "Action label".

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called when the close icon is clicked; omit to hide the close affordance.

props.name: height
props.description: Scale height in px (value `max` maps to this).

props.name: max
props.description: Value mapped to full scale height; defaults to the largest datum rounded up to a "nice" step.

props.name: ticks
props.description: Number of y-axis ticks / gridlines, including 0 and `max`.

props.name: showValues
props.description: Prints each value above its bar — Figma's "Show values".

props.name: highlightLatest
props.description: Newest bar keeps chart/series-1, the rest turn icon/muted — Figma's "Highlight latest".

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats tick and value labels; defaults to en-US numbers (`1,284`).

props.name: labelHeader
props.description: Column headers. Defaults follow the Figma sample.

props.name: min
props.description: Below `min` is Critical, at or above `ideal` is Healthy.

props.name: context
props.description: One-line context under the title. Figma's "Context".

props.name: showHandle
props.description: Figma's "Show handle".

props.name: overlay
props.description: Render fixed to the viewport bottom on the Scrim.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default 'primary'.

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'md'.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as its child (Radix Slot) instead of a <button> — e.g. an <a>.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in place of the leading icon and dims the label.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label — maps to Figma's "Leading icon" slot.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered after the label. Figma only models a leading slot, but a trailing affordance is required by real triggers (a dropdown chevron), so this is an additive extension rather than something the design contradicts.

props.name: state
props.description: Maps to Figma's "State" variant. `default` renders children.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Message shown in the empty state.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Message shown in the error state.

props.name: heading
props.description: Header — the x value being read (e.g. a date).

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'md'.

props.name: align
props.description: Default 'center'.

props.name: state
props.description: Default 'default'.

props.name: icon
props.description: Figma's "Leading icon" swap. Hidden in Done / Counted, where the check and count take the space.

props.name: count
props.description: Count shown in the Badge for Done / Counted.

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'md'.

props.name: error
props.description: Error is a prop (arbitrary validity has no CSS hook); also sets aria-invalid.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Start open — documents Figma's State=Open; not needed in product.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the value field.

props.name: date
props.description: The formatted date, e.g. "Wednesday, May 27, 2026".

props.name: tag
props.description: Optional short context label shown as a Tag, e.g. "SEM 22". Figma's "Show tag".

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: Month currently displayed; defaults to `value`'s month or today.

props.name: disableFuture
props.description: Disable every date after today (Figma: "use with disableFuture").

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Return true for days that cannot be chosen; they render greyed and never fire onChange.

props.name: categories
props.description: One label per data point (the x axis).

props.name: axisLabels
props.description: Labels shown under the axis; defaults to every category.

props.name: forecastFrom
props.description: Points from this index onward are the forecast (dashed, shaded).

props.name: band
props.type: { from: number; to: number; label: string }

props.name: min
props.description: Fixed y range; defaults to the data range padded to nice numbers.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit under the centre total, e.g. "USD".

props.name: centerLabel
props.description: Figma's "Center label".

props.name: texture
props.description: Give each part its series texture as well as its colour (print, greyscale, colour-blind use).

props.name: overlay
props.description: Render on the Scrim, docked right (fixed, full-height). Default false: body only.

props.name: label
props.description: Trigger label. Ignored when `trigger` is provided.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Custom trigger. Receives nothing — wire your own onClick via the wrapper.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Maps to Figma's State=Searchable: search field on top, Clear at the bottom.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called by Clear (after the query is reset) so the owner can clear its selection.

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph inside the 56px badge; defaults to the inbox.

props.name: action
props.description: The one primary action, e.g. `<Button>Add account</Button>`.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text shown below the field — becomes the error message when `error` is set.

props.name: variant
props.description: Default 'primary'.

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'md'.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon glyph — swap for any Lucide icon.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required — an icon-only control has no visible label.

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'md'.

props.name: error
props.description: Default false.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the value — maps to Figma's "Leading icon" slot.

props.name: texture
props.description: Show each series' texture in its swatch, to match a textured chart.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed plot width in px. Leave it out and the chart fills its container.

props.name: height
props.description: Plot height in px.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Formats y-axis labels; defaults to one decimal with a comma (`0,9`).

props.name: external
props.description: Figma "External": adds the inline arrow suffix and opens in a new tab safely.

props.name: standalone
props.description: Standalone (not inside running text): 24px min height, 48px touch target.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Skeleton rows rendered while loading.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Figma's "Subtitle" + "Show subtitle".

props.name: icon
props.description: Figma's "Icon" + "Show icon".

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon swap. Falls back to a placeholder circle when `leadingIcon` is on, like Figma.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Maps to Figma's "Leading icon" boolean. Default true.

props.name: type
props.description: Maps to Figma's "Type" variant.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Render on the Scrim (fixed, full-viewport). Default false: body only.

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'md'.

props.name: error
props.description: Default false.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when no <label> points at the field; defaults to the placeholder.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Maps to Figma's State=Disabled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Maps to Figma's State=Open — the initial open state; the component tracks it afterwards.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page, 1-indexed.

props.name: length
props.description: Number of digits. Figma documents 4.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; turns every box semantic/error.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once all digits are entered.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Hide the "label / value%" row and render only the track.

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'md'.

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'md'.

props.name: error
props.description: Default false.

props.name: range
props.description: First and last x-axis labels, shown under every panel.

props.name: columns
props.description: Most panels per row; fewer when the container is narrow.

props.name: highlight
props.description: Index of one panel to emphasise; the others turn neutral.

props.name: independentScales
props.description: Give each panel its own y-scale. Off by default, on purpose.

props.name: unit
props.description: Unit for the shared-scale footer (e.g. "USD").

props.name: plotHeight
props.description: Plot height of each panel, px.

props.name: width
props.description: SVG width in px.

props.name: height
props.description: SVG height in px.

props.name: type
props.description: Figma's Type.

props.name: showTotals
props.description: Total above each bar (Absolute only). Figma's "Show totals".

props.name: height
props.description: Scale height in px.

props.name: max
props.description: Top of the absolute scale; defaults to the largest total rounded up.

props.name: texture
props.description: Figma's Texture = Pattern: each series also gets its texture (print, greyscale, colour-blind use).

props.name: delta
props.description: Delta shown under the value, e.g. "12,5 %".

props.name: trend
props.description: Colour + arrow for the delta: up = ▲ success, down = ▼ error, neutral = muted (no arrow).

props.name: deltaCaption
props.description: Caption after the delta, e.g. "vs. last month".

props.name: size
props.description: Default 'md'.

props.name: error
props.description: Default false.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Default false.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Skeleton rows rendered while loading.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Card chrome (border, radius, surface). Turn off when the table sits inside another container that already owns the chrome, e.g. Content Panel.

props.name: filters
props.description: Active filters, rendered as dismissible chips after the search field.

props.name: secondaryAction
props.description: Secondary action — an icon-only control, e.g. `<IconButton variant="secondary" icon={<Download />} aria-label="Export" />`.

props.name: primaryAction
props.description: The one primary action, e.g. `<Button>Add account</Button>`.

props.name: color
props.description: Default 'neutral'.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Shows a close icon — maps to Figma's "Dismissible" boolean prop.

props.name: error
props.description: Default false.

props.name: color
props.description: Maps to Figma's "Color" variant.

props.name: breadcrumb
props.description: Left slot, usually a Breadcrumb.

props.name: center
props.description: Centre slot, usually a DateIndicator.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right slot, usually TopbarAction buttons.
